template:
#!/bin/sh
basedir=$(dirname "$(echo "$0" | sed -e 's,\\,/,g')")

case `uname` in
    *CYGWIN*) basedir=`cygpath -w "$basedir"`;;
esac

if [ -z "$NODE_PATH" ]; then
  export NODE_PATH="{{moduleSearchPath}}"
else
  export NODE_PATH="{{moduleSearchPath}}:$NODE_PATH"
fi
if [ -x "$basedir/node" ]; then
  exec "$basedir/node"  "{{localEntrypoint}}" "$@"
else
  exec node  "{{localEntrypoint}}" "$@"
fi
